setting: A student schedules a first visit at the campus counseling center and learns about wait times and confidentiality.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a staff member at the counseling center.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to make an appointment with a counselor. I've been feeling overwhelmed with midterms.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Of course. Is this your first time with us?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Yes. Do I need a referral from my doctor?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No referral for a first visit. I can offer a twenty-minute intake this week, then a full session after that.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: How soon is the intake? My exam is Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: We have a cancellation tomorrow at eleven, or Friday at nine. Tomorrow fills first.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Tomorrow at eleven, please. Will my professors be told I came here?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No. Visits are confidential unless there's a safety risk. We don't contact instructors without your written permission.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That's a relief. Should I bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Just your student ID, and arrive ten minutes early for forms. If you need same-day crisis help, use the after-hours number on our website—don't wait for the intake.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll see you tomorrow at eleven. Thanks.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.text: Getting a medical referral for a specialist off campus
Complaining about a professor's teaching style

questions.explanation: He books a first counseling intake because he feels overwhelmed with midterms.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—midterms explain stress, not a request to change exam dates.

questions.narrator_text: What kind of appointment can he get this week?

options.text: A meeting that requires a doctor's referral first
A twenty-minute intake, then a full session later
An online group class with no individual meeting
A full hour-long therapy session only

questions.explanation: No referral for a first visit; she offers a twenty-minute intake this week, then a full session after.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing C—she says no referral is needed for the first visit.
questions.correctAnswer: A twenty-minute intake, then a full session later

questions.explanation: He chooses the cancellation tomorrow at eleven over Friday at nine.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because Friday was offered—he picks tomorrow.

questions.narrator_text: What does the staff member say about confidentiality?

options.text: Parents must approve every appointment in writing
Professors are automatically emailed after each visit
Visits are confidential unless there is a safety risk

questions.explanation: She says visits are confidential unless there is a safety risk; instructors are not contacted without written permission.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A—he worried professors would be told; she says the opposite.
questions.correctAnswer: Visits are confidential unless there is a safety risk
